newsitem.title: CANADA: Dominion Textile cancels India venture.
newsitem.headline: Dominion Textile cancels India venture.

text.p: Dominion Textile Inc said on Wednesday that it agreed with LNJ Bhilwara Group to cancel their proposed joint venture project to build a denim manufacturing facility in India.

The joint venture in the state of Madhya Pradesh had faced delays, and an alternative became necessary to meet targeted product and service levels for Dominion Textile's Swift Denim division Far East customer base.

Swift Europe, Dominion Textile's European denim affiliate, would make some of its value-added production available to Swift's Far East customers and Swift North America would accelerate the conversion of existing basic denim capacity to value-added production, the company said.
Dominion Textile said its joint venture with the Sauler Group to build a nonwoven facility in Argentina was progressing on plan and production start-up was scheduled for autumn 1997.
